theorem lg_target (K : Type u_7) {L : Type u_8} [Field K] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra K L] [Module.Finite K L] (x : L) : Module.finrank K ↥(LieSubalgebra.engel K x) = (LinearMap.charpoly ((LieAlgebra.ad K L) x)).natTrailingDegree := by
  let S := LieSubalgebra.engel K x
  let ad_x := LieAlgebra.ad K L x
  have h_ad_S_nilpotent : LieRing.IsNilpotent (↥S) := by apply LieSubalgebra.isNilpotent_of_engel
  let Φ := LinearMap.traceForm K L
  have hΦ_nondeg : Φ.Nondegenerate := by apply LinearMap.BilinForm.nondegenerate_traceForm
  have hΦ_inv : LinearMap.BilinForm.lieInvariant L Φ := by apply LinearMap.BilinForm.traceForm_lieInvariant
  have hΦ_refl : Φ.IsRefl := by apply LinearMap.BilinForm.traceForm_isRefl
  have hΦ_restrict_nondeg : Φ.restrict (↥S) Nondegenerate := by apply LinearMap.BilinForm.restrict_nondegenerate
  have hΦ_restrict_inv : LinearMap.BilinForm.lieInvariant (↥S) (Φ.restrict (↥S)) := by apply LinearMap.BilinForm.restrict_lieInvariant
  have hΦ_restrict_refl : (Φ.restrict (↥S)).IsRefl := by apply LinearMap.BilinForm.restrict_isRefl
  have hΦ_restrict_atomistic : LinearMap.BilinForm.atomistic (↥S) (Φ.restrict (↥S)) := by apply LinearMap.BilinForm.atomistic_restrict
  let traceForm_S := Φ.restrict (↥S)
  let traceForm_S_charpoly := LinearMap.charpoly (LieAlgebra.ad K (↥S) x)
  have h_traceForm_S_charpoly_deg_eq_finrank : Module.finrank K ↥S = traceForm_S_charpoly.natTrailingDegree := 
    by apply LieModule.traceForm_eq_sum_finrank_nsmul_mul
  let h_charpoly_deg_eq_traceForm_S_charpoly_deg : (LinearMap.charpoly ad_x).natTrailingDegree = traceForm_S_charpoly.natTrailingDegree := 
    by apply LinearMap.charpoly_ad_eq_traceForm_charpoly
  exact (h_traceForm_S_charpoly_deg_eq_finrank.trans h_charpoly_deg_eq_traceForm_S_charpoly_deg).symm
